6. Harm Identification: This constitutes 'Diagnostic Integrity Harm' (accepting unsupported/fabricated diagnosis) and 'Procedural Negligence Harm' (bypassing verification of evidence). The primary harm is the acceptance of the fabricated diagnosis.
